name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.LeafView.succ_gadget_exists
title: A Z_q gadget matrix with G = Def_SuccinctLWE's gadget and binary decompositions
statement: For q > 0 and q <= 2^k there is a GadgetMatrix Gamma over Z_q with Gamma.G = gadget n k q (the G of Def_SuccinctLWE), entries of Gamma.ginv A of centered absolute value at most 1, and a decomposition dec with G dec(y) = y and entries of centered absolute value at most 1.
